title: Gymnopédies
notes: Three slow, sparse, melancholic piano miniatures that quietly defied conventional harmony.

title: Gnossiennes
notes: Barless, modal piano pieces with ostinato bass, odd instructions and uneasy melancholy.

title: Vexations
notes: Short tritone-laden bass theme and chorale, very slow, notionally repeated 840 times.

title: Parade
notes: Music-hall ballet with ragtime, typewriter, pistol and sirens; caused an opening-night uproar.

title: Musique d'ameublement
notes: Short repeated refrains meant as background, to mingle with chatter: proto-ambient.
